title: Tokyo precip vs ZW=F null control
hypothesis: R2 | [fertilizer-ag] Tokyo daily precipitation 20d z-score is unrelated to ZW=F log returns at lags 0-10 days (null control); no trade [weather.tokyo.precip -> finance.ZW=F.log_return] (parent: R2-0057)
message: Null control holds: Tokyo precip z-score vs ZW=F returns is noise (perm p=0.63, Bonferroni p=1.0, best lag r=0.10, OOS hit rate 29%); no trade.

trade_idea.entry_rule: weather.tokyo.precip rolling_zscore_20d > 1 at close -> long ZW=F next session
trade_idea.exit_rule: close after 9 trading days (no overlapping entries)
trade_idea.caveats: Backtest on daily closes, no costs/slippage; few independent regimes; signal and target may share the war as common cause.
